question: The Dadasaheb Phalke Award is the highest award for recognising contributions of famous personalities in the field of:
solution:
The correct answer is **Cinema**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Dadasaheb Phalke Award** is the highest recognition in the field of **Indian cinema**.
 
• It was instituted in **1969** by the Government of India.
 
• The award is named after **Dadasaheb Phalke**, who is considered the **father of Indian cinema**.
